content.value_statement: Educational slide decks often miss learner level, structure, and review criteria. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through NotebookLM prompts, checks, and file naming.
actual_capabilities: Provides A2, B1, and C1 prompt patterns for NotebookLM slide generation.
Defines a repeatable browser workflow for creating, reviewing, downloading, and moving slide PDFs.
Supplies seven review gates for title, language, themes, tone, count, arc, and ending.
Recommends file naming and README frontmatter for chapter slide integration.
Describes batch processing and troubleshooting for multiple chapters.
limitations: Requires access to NotebookLM and any limits set by Google.
Depends on browser-use for browser automation steps.
Does not generate slides locally or provide a presentation engine.
Focuses on educational chapter decks, not sales or general business presentations.

use_cases.title: Build Beginner Course Decks
use_cases.description: Turn chapter material into simple A2 slide decks with clear language and concrete learner actions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Chapter Slide Delivery
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable naming, review, and README integration process for published course chapters.

use_cases.title: Scale Advanced Technical Lessons
use_cases.description: Use C1 prompts to request rigorous decks with trade-offs, diagrams, and deployment-focused endings.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Beginner Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for A2 learners with little prior knowledge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A2 NotebookLM slide deck for chapter [number] about [topic]. Use simple language, 12 to 15 slides, concrete examples, and specific next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Intermediate Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for learners who know the basics and need practical context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a B1 NotebookLM slide deck for chapter [number]. Include practical examples, required background, 15 to 20 slides, and implementation strategies.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Advanced Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for experienced learners who need analysis and trade-offs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a C1 NotebookLM slide deck for chapter [number]. Include industry patterns, decision points, diagrams, 20 to 25 slides, and production strategies.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Chapter Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when generating slides for several chapters in one work session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan NotebookLM slide generation for chapters [range]. Prepare prompts, review gates, download names, and a daily schedule within NotebookLM limits.

output_examples.input: A beginner programming chapter with lesson text, quiz notes, and a README.
output_examples.output: A 12 to 15 slide NotebookLM prompt plan with simple language, theme coverage, and concrete learner tasks.

output_examples.input: An advanced AI tooling chapter for experienced developers.
output_examples.output: A C1 slide request focused on trade-offs, architecture diagrams, decision matrices, and production deployment strategies.

output_examples.input: Three course chapters that need consistent slide PDFs.
output_examples.output: A batch workflow with notebook creation order, prompt preparation, review gates, download names, and README integration notes.

best_practices: Define learner proficiency before asking NotebookLM for slides.
Provide numbered themes with concrete examples and data.
Review every deck against the seven success gates before publishing.
anti_patterns: Using a vague audience description and expecting accurate level control.
Accepting text-heavy slides without revising the prompt.
Downloading PDFs without a stable naming and README integration plan.

faq.question: Does this skill create slides without NotebookLM?
faq.answer: No. It guides NotebookLM slide generation and review. It does not include a local slide renderer.

faq.question: Which learner levels does it support?
faq.answer: It provides prompt patterns for A2 beginners, B1 intermediate learners, and C1 advanced practitioners.

faq.question: Can it process many chapters?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a batch workflow, but NotebookLM daily limits can restrict output volume.

faq.question: Does it require browser automation?
faq.answer: The workflow references browser-use for NotebookLM navigation. Users can also perform the steps manually.

faq.question: What files does it help prepare?
faq.answer: It focuses on downloaded slide PDFs and README frontmatter references for course chapters.

faq.question: Is it suitable for business pitch decks?
faq.answer: Not primarily. It is designed for educational chapter decks with proficiency and pedagogy controls.
